limits: Actual expected build and World at exact clear/end clocks;1/5/10/20 targets measure group capacity for the authored budget calculation.

Targets have explicit high HP, zero attack/armour and no hostile skills. Player HP, mana, cooldowns and skill execution receive no overrides. Nonzero incoming damage or invalid build output is reported as invalid, never discarded.
Immortal targets do not trigger kill effects. This reference is separate from finite actual swarm/normal camp kills and natural route rates.
The5/10-target diagnostics cannot replace the fixed12/20-target1.5-times acceptance measurement. No threshold or target count is reduced.
